title: Doosan DNM 5700 machine states Z travel -510..0 (machine frame): every move above the work origin is refused at the post, as in #457

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

On the built-in **Doosan DNM 5700** machine, the post gate refuses every move above the work origin's Z0: every clearance, retract and cut above the origin. The cause is that its Z travel is stated in the machine frame. A plain face job's first rapid already fails:

```
post: post blocked - machine Doosan DNM 5700: 40 limit problem(s): F1: move 0 reaches 35.000 in Z, the stroke is -510.000..0.000; F1: move 1 reaches 10.000 in Z, the stroke is -510.000..0.000; ...
```

This is the #457 defect, which `vmc.mch` and `tilthead.mch` were fixed for, in the machine registered later by #614.

## Reproduction (main 38699549, `camcraft-cli mcp`)

`assets/machines/doosan-dnm.mch` and `crates/app/src/machine/mod.rs` are unchanged from there to 3f6ecb4a.

```json
[["load_machine", {"builtin": "Doosan DNM 5700"}],
 ["set_stock", {"box": {"dx": 60, "dy": 40, "dz": 10}}],
 ["add_tool", {"catalog": "EM-1000-4FL"}],
 ["add_operation", {"kind": "face", "tool": "EM-1000-4FL", "name": "F1"}],
 ["generate", {"name": "F1"}], ["verify", {}],
 ["post", {"output": "f1.nc", "post": "Doosan DNM"}]]
```

`verify` returns one `post_gate` finding (`blocks_post: true`) with the 40 limit problems, and `post` refuses with them as quoted above.

## Neighbour case that works

The same calls with `{"builtin": "VMC 3-axis"}` and the `Fanuc` post: `verify` is clean, and the post writes 40 lines (`G00 X-35 Y-15 Z35`, `G01 ... Z10 F300`, ...). The program is the same; only the machine's stated bands differ.

## Root cause (confirmed)

`assets/machines/AGENTS.md` (the `travel` bullet) says:

> a stroke in PROGRAM coordinates ... The file cannot know the work offset, so a linear slide of stroke L is written `-L..L` - the FULL stroke each way, never the machine-frame band (`-500..0` for a 500 mm column refuses every retract above the work origin, #457 ...)

`doosan-dnm.mch` states:

- **Z:** `{ "min": -510.0, "max": 0.0 }`, the machine-frame band. The limit check (`crates/app/src/machine/mod.rs`, the travel loop) reads `(w - origin) * sign` against it, so every move above the work origin fails.
- **X and Y:** `-510..510` and `-285..285`, half the catalog strokes in the file's own description ("X/Y/Z: 1020/570/510mm"). The rule's full-stroke-each-way form is `-1020..1020` and `-570..570`. As stated, a program whose work origin sits at a table corner is refused once it runs past 510 mm in X or 285 mm in Y.

Every other shipped mill file states a symmetric Z band (`vmc.mch` and `tilthead.mch` ±500, `grblhal-3axis.mch` ±100, the Tormach, Sienci and Carvera files ± their figures). `load_machine` derives the table from the same numbers: `"table": {"max": [510.0, 285.0, -510.0], ...}`.

## Expected

The DNM file follows the travel rule: `-1020..1020`, `-570..570` and `-510..510`. The face job posts as it does on the built-in VMC. A test like `crates/app/tests/vmc_stroke.rs` (#477) pins it.

## Suggested labels

Outside contributors can't set labels, so these are suggestions:

- `P3`: a legal program on a shipped machine is refused. Another machine is the only workaround.
- `effort:high`: the fix is a data change plus a pinning test, but it moves the travel and collision laws, so the safety floor applies.
- `area:post`
- `source:agent`
